tip.title: firecrawl/firecrawl
tip.body:
**场景：** 用 `firecrawl` 抓取网页内容时，直接返回原始 HTML 或 Markdown 可能混入广告、导航栏等噪声，影响下游 RAG 或 LLM 解析质量。

**做法：** 使用 `firecrawl` 的 `scrape` API 并指定 `formats: ["markdown"]` 和 `onlyMainContent: true`，自动过滤非正文元素。

```python
from firecrawl import FirecrawlApp

app = FirecrawlApp(api_key="your-key")
result = app.scrape_url(
    "https://example.com/article",
    params={"formats": ["markdown"], "onlyMainContent": True}
)
clean_text = result["markdown"]
```

**注意：** 该参数由服务端处理，本地无需执行任何模型生成的代码，安全无风险。

items.title: Nvidia finds that simple linear math can replace costly AI model handoffs
items.raw_text: When an agentic AI system hands a task from a small model to a larger one — or back down again — it pays a steep tax: the receiving model has to recompute the entire conversation from scratch, driving up compute costs and latency. This is a major bottleneck for enterprises building long-horizon, multi-LLM workflows. To solve this challenge, researchers at Nvidia have introduced a cross-model KV cache transfer technique that directly maps the prefilled KV cache from a source model into the target model. This technique aligns with real-world agentic applications where large contexts accumulate across many turns. items.title: Slack wants to drag AI coding out of the terminal and into the group chat
items.raw_text: Slack wants to drag AI coding out of the terminal and into the group chat. The Salesforce-owned messaging platform today announced Slack Code , a new product that embeds AI coding agents — including Anthropic's Claude Code , Cognition's Devin , GitHub Copilot , and Vercel's agent — directly into dedicated Slack channels where entire teams can watch, steer, review, and ship software together. Slack Code is available on any Slack plan at launch, though customers need their own access to the partner agents. The pitch is deceptively simple: today, most work with AI coding agents happens between one person and one agent, invisible to everyone else. Slack Code makes that work " multiplayer ." items.title: One in five enterprises can't stop a runaway AI agent's spending in real time
items.raw_text: Enterprise AI teams have stopped betting on a single orchestration platform. The median enterprise now runs three at once — not by accident, but because none of them fully trusts a single vendor to run the show, according to VB Pulse data . This is not just to avoid vendor lock-in and retain flexibility (although that’s a big part of it). There’s still a lot of uncertainty, even distrust, in vendors’ security and permissioning capabilities. Enterprises want the ability to impose their own. Microsoft leads on primary usage today, while Anthropic leads by a wide margin in what enterprises are considering next. items.summary: 调查显示五分之一企业无法实时控制AI Agent支出，暴露治理短板。
